# Aquarell Tutorials: Drawing, Layers and Export

> Start with a canvas, brushes and layers. Practise leaves, flowers, still life and landscapes, then learn PNG, JPEG, PSD and native-project saving.

## App and version

- [Aquarell: Watercolour Drawing for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/aquarell/index.md): Draw on iPhone and iPad with Aquarell brushes, layers and palettes. Follow a beginner tutorial, then save a PNG, JPEG, layered PSD or native project.
Version listed: 1.0.7; checked 2026-11-10; iOS 15.0+ / iPadOS 15.0+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Aquarell getting started: create a canvas, draw in layers and export PNG](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-getting-started/index.md): Start with a simple drawing exercise to learn canvas settings, the role of each layer, brush adjustments and PNG or native-project export in Aquarell. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [2. Aquarell canvas sizes: plan pixels and DPI for blog images](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-canvas-size-dpi/index.md): Use a banner, square illustration and small print to distinguish canvas pixels, display width and DPI, so the size fits the intended use before you finish drawing. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [3. Aquarell brush basics: compare size and opacity in a nine-cell study](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-brush-size-opacity/index.md): Compare brush size and opacity in a nine-cell exercise, distinguishing a single stroke, repeated colour buildup and layer opacity. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [4. Aquarell brush spacing: continuous lines, dotted textures and borders](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-brush-spacing/index.md): Keep brush size fixed and compare low, medium and high spacing, then use the results for dotted decoration and hand-drawn borders. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [5. Aquarell layers: separate sketch, colour and details](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-three-layer-workflow/index.md): Build a three-layer workflow, understand layer order, the active layer and visibility, then use a simple plant illustration to check that edits stay independent. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [6. Aquarell layer opacity: lighten sketches and adjust overlapping colour](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-layer-opacity/index.md): Use sketches, shadows and highlights to understand what layer opacity affects, and distinguish brush transparency from compositing a whole layer. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [7. Aquarell colour basics: build a five-colour illustration palette](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-limited-palette/index.md): Give colours roles as background, subject, shadow and accent, then select and save a palette in Aquarell to reduce arbitrary colour changes while drawing. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [8. Aquarell colour sampling: keep touch-ups, shadows and details consistent](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-canvas-color-picking/index.md): Sample from existing colour areas rather than repeatedly guessing, and check deviations caused by transparent overlaps and edge sampling. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [9. Draw a leaf in Aquarell: from outline to soft veins](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-paint-leaf/index.md): Draw a simple leaf in three layers, practising shape, colour areas, one-sided shadow and a hierarchy of veins, then export your exercise. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [10. Draw a five-petal flower in Aquarell: rhythm, warm and cool colour, and depth](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-paint-flower/index.md): Arrange five petals, then practise the main colour, shadows at their bases, the flower centre and empty space without replacing the overall shape with excessive fine lines. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [11. Draw a cup in Aquarell: ellipses, volume and cast shadow](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-paint-cup/index.md): Build a cup from its rim, body and handle, then use one-sided shading, a bright edge and a table shadow to describe simple volume. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [12. Draw a three-depth landscape in Aquarell: mountains, middle ground and silhouette](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-paint-landscape/index.md): Use the tonal relationship of sky, distant mountains and foreground to practise depth. Separate layers, then check that the landscape stays readable on a small screen. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [13. Aquarell illustrated cards: arrange a title, drawing and empty space](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-illustrated-card/index.md): Plan the text area, illustration and margins of a portrait greeting card, using the text and font controls to make a readable small card. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [14. Draw an icon family in Aquarell: consistent sizes, lines and colours](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-icon-series/index.md): Use a leaf, cup and flower to establish shared canvas, visual-size and colour rules, so three separate drawings feel like one family. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [15. Aquarell transparent PNG: check backgrounds and white edges](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-transparent-png/index.md): Check the background layer and actual pixels, export a transparent PNG, then inspect solid white areas, edges and the file format after sharing on light and dark backgrounds. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [16. Aquarell blog-image export: compare JPEG quality and file size](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-jpeg-for-blog/index.md): Choose output dimensions for the real display width, compare JPEG and PNG edges and textures, and reduce damage from repeated compression. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [17. Before exporting Aquarell PSD: raster layers, text and delivery notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-psd-handoff/index.md): Organise the layers for delivery, compare the PSD with a preview, and explain raster layers, editable text and native projects to the recipient. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [18. Save native Aquarell projects: keep drafts, finished work and shared images separate](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-native-artwork-backup/index.md): Use clear filenames and three checks to retain editable Aquarell projects, rather than treating a finished PNG or PSD as the only original. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [19. Troubleshoot blurry Aquarell exports: pixels, scaling, brushes and compression](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-export-blur-check/index.md): Locate blur at the original, exported-file or published-page stage, distinguishing insufficient pixels, soft brushwork, JPEG compression and webpage enlargement. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [20. Aquarell local colouring: limit brushwork with selections, then understand masks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-selection-local-color/index.md): Use a separate practice image to limit brush marks with a selection, check whether it is still active, and distinguish temporary regions, layer masks and direct erasing. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [21. Aquarell crosshatching: shade a sphere without a solid fill](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-crosshatching-sphere/index.md): Use the direction, spacing and overlap of single-colour lines to draw a sphere, practising reserved highlights, the light–shadow boundary and contact shadow. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [22. Stipple a pear in Aquarell: describe volume with dot density](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-stippling-pear/index.md): Build a pear’s outline, midtones and cast shadow from individual short marks, practising dot size, density and negative space. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [23. Aquarell negative-space painting: reserve winter branches in the sky](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-negative-space-branches/index.md): Paint the sky between branches to practise negative space, branching rhythm, edge cleanup and unpainted areas in Aquarell. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [24. Aquarell edge study: draw three stones with hard, soft and lost edges](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-edge-study-stones/index.md): Use three stones to practise clear, soft and disappearing edges, arranging overlaps, contact shadows and surface changes. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [25. Aquarell warm–cool still life: an orange against blue cloth](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-warm-cool-still-life/index.md): Practise colour temperature, value, area ratios and reflected light with an orange and blue cloth, avoiding equally saturated complementary-colour blocks. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [26. Paint a night window in Aquarell: make a little warm light the focus](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-lit-window/index.md): Use a night window to practise a large dark area, a small warm light, window-frame overlaps and reflected light on the wall. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [27. Paint rainy-night reflections in Aquarell: vertical colour on wet pavement](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-rainy-reflections/index.md): Start from three lights and organise vertical reflections, horizontal breaks and near-to-far perspective on wet pavement without making the whole road a mirror. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [28. Aquarell wave study: separate the crest, body and foam with value](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-ocean-foam/index.md): Build a wave from dark sea, a lighter wave body and a little foam, practising movement, broken edges and control of white areas. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [29. Aquarell cloud study: separate the lit and shaded planes of a white cloud](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-cloud-shapes/index.md): Draw a cumulus cloud with a broad outline and a few shaded areas, practising its top and base, hard and soft edges and open sky. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [30. Aquarell fabric folds: organise shadows around the direction of tension](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-fabric-folds/index.md): Draw cloth hanging from one point, first identifying tension, fold direction and planes, then placing shadows, bright bands and the hem. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [31. Paint breakfast toast in Aquarell: distinguish bread, butter and jam](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-breakfast-toast/index.md): Practise three materials on one slice of toast, using colour, edges, pores and highlights to separate bread, butter and jam. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [32. Paint woodland mushrooms in Aquarell: caps, gills and mossy ground](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-woodland-mushrooms/index.md): Use one large and one small mushroom to practise cap thickness, gill direction and woodland depth in a simple nature illustration. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [33. Aquarell cat silhouettes: keep the pose with a few furry edges](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-cat-silhouette/index.md): Establish a seated cat with four main shapes for head, chest, haunches and tail, then control ears, negative space and a few furry edges without drawing every hair. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [34. Paint a moth in Aquarell: balance wing patterns by hand](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-moth-pattern/index.md): Draw a moth’s outline and wing patterns manually, using a centre axis, corresponding points and varied density to balance the sides without mirror drawing. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [35. Aquarell rooftop sketch: use two sets of converging lines for a street corner](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-city-rooftops/index.md): Draw three simplified corner buildings using a horizon, two convergence directions and roof thickness to establish space, then add a few windows. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [36. Aquarell monochrome portrait: place the features before shading](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-monochrome-portrait/index.md): Practise the head shape, relative feature positions, three values and edges in a single-colour portrait, avoiding detailed eyes too early. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [37. Aquarell hand sketch: break a pose into palm and finger joints](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-hand-construction/index.md): Divide a hand into palm, thumb and bent finger segments to practise length, overlap and negative space, then finish with a little shading. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [38. Paint a glass bottle in Aquarell: suggest transparency with background and edges](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-glass-bottle/index.md): Use the visible background, light and dark edges and a few highlights to distinguish a glass bottle’s rim, body, liquid level and table shadow. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [39. Aquarell seed-pod study: show the seed arrangement in a cutaway](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-seedpod-cutaway/index.md): Draw an open seed pod, observing four types of shape: outer shell, inner wall, seeds and their attachment points. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [40. Draw a four-panel story in Aquarell: keep one character’s actions coherent](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-four-panel-story/index.md): Arrange four panels manually, using a consistent character, changing actions, gaze direction and empty space to tell a short story without dialogue. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [41. Paint a pine cone in Aquarell: turn the scales around a curved form](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-pinecone-spirals/index.md): Draw a pine cone with staggered scales and shaded gaps, changing repeated forms as they turn around its volume. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [42. Paint a cactus in Aquarell: build the ribs before adding spines](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-cactus-spines/index.md): Paint a potted columnar cactus, using ribs, spaced spine clusters and the pot rim to distinguish volume from surface detail. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [43. Paint a small bird in Aquarell: organise feathers into directional masses](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-bird-feather-groups/index.md): Paint a perched bird with clear head and chest volumes, a wing mass and selected feathers instead of isolated individual marks. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [44. Paint underwater koi in Aquarell: separate body, markings and surface](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-koi-underwater/index.md): Paint a turning koi with a curved body, delicate fins and restrained surface cues that place it underwater. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [45. Paint a scallop shell in Aquarell: turn radial ridges across its surface](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-seashell-ridges/index.md): Draw a scallop shell with a fan silhouette, radial ridges and broken highlights, controlling the width and values of repeated grooves. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [46. Paint a strawberry in Aquarell: wrap the seeds around the fruit](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-strawberry-seeds/index.md): Paint a strawberry through its heart-shaped volume, red value changes and seed dimples, balancing highlights against repeated detail. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [47. Paint a lemon slice in Aquarell: separate rind, pith and translucent flesh](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-lemon-slice/index.md): Paint a lemon cross-section with rind rings, uneven segments and local highlights, preserving both irregularity and the overall ellipse. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [48. Paint a croissant in Aquarell: wrap pastry layers around the rolled form](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-croissant-folds/index.md): Paint a croissant with a crescent silhouette, rolled sections and baked colour changes, separating its main volume from flaky texture. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [49. Paint a metal kettle in Aquarell: describe reflections with bands of light](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-metal-kettle/index.md): Paint a metal kettle, distinguishing reflected bands, edge lights and cast shadow while controlling high-contrast areas. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [50. Paint a wicker basket in Aquarell: wrap woven texture around the form](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-wicker-basket/index.md): Build a wicker basket from rim, walls and handle, then use staggered marks and varied density without flattening its volume. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [51. Paint a misty pine forest in Aquarell: build distance with decreasing contrast](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-fog-pine-forest/index.md): Paint a misty forest with three tree groups and decreasing value contrast instead of covering everything with uniform white. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [52. Paint a lake reflection in Aquarell: preserve alignment, then break the detail](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-lake-reflection/index.md): Paint shoreline trees and their reflections, checking vertical alignment before using broken horizontal strokes to describe ripples. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [53. Paint a snowy cabin in Aquarell: give white snow coloured shadows](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-snow-cabin/index.md): Paint a snow-covered cabin with roof thickness, coloured snow shadows and a warm window so the snow retains form. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [54. Paint desert dunes in Aquarell: connect curved planes with crests and shadows](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-desert-dunes/index.md): Paint three dune groups with lit and shaded slopes and restrained foreground ripples to establish direction and scale. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [55. Paint a room corner in Aquarell: organise the interior with one vanishing point](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-interior-one-point/index.md): Paint a simple room with floor, window and desk, establishing consistent perspective before separating walls and furniture with light. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [56. Paint a travel journal spread in Aquarell: balance a main sketch, route and writing space](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-travel-journal-spread/index.md): Plan a fictional walking-day journal spread with a central gutter, sketch hierarchy, hand-lettered title and usable writing space. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [57. Paint an illustrated recipe in Aquarell: connect ingredients, actions and results](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-illustrated-recipe/index.md): Design a fictional fruit-yoghurt recipe, separating quantities, steps and the finished dish while checking text and image consistency. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [58. Paint a botanical initial in Aquarell: support a readable letter with leaves](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-botanical-initial/index.md): Combine a hand-lettered Latin initial with botanical forms, checking counters, strokes and overlaps for readability at small size. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [59. Paint one scene through four seasons in Aquarell: keep the composition, change the cues](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-seasonal-scene-quartet/index.md): Paint a tree and path in spring, summer, autumn and winter, preserving viewpoint and positions while comparing colour, foliage and ground cues. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [60. Review Aquarell artwork: compare stage previews and choose the next study goal](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-artwork-review-sheet/index.md): Review four stage previews for structure, values, edges and export, then define a practical goal for the next drawing. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [61. Paint an origami crane in Aquarell: explain structure through planes and overlaps](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-paper-crane-planes/index.md): Study planar turns, same-colour values and overlapping wings through an origami crane. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [62. Paint an umbrella in Aquarell: describe an open canopy through ribs and panels](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-umbrella-ribs/index.md): Study an open umbrella through its silhouette, radiating ribs, curved panels and shaft connection. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [63. Paint a bicycle wheel in Aquarell: align spokes, hub and rim in one ellipse](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-bicycle-wheel-spokes/index.md): Study a tilted wheel through concentric ellipses, spoke density and tyre thickness without hiding an off-centre hub in linework. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [64. Paint a sneaker in Aquarell: weave laces around the tongue](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-sneaker-laces/index.md): Study a sneaker’s sole, upper, eyelets and crossing laces through coherent volume and overlaps. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [65. Paint headphones in Aquarell: separate shells, cushions and joints](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-headphones-cushions/index.md): Study hard and soft materials, elliptical thickness and joints through two earcups and a curved headband. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [66. Paint a dandelion seed head in Aquarell: preserve air through density and omission](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-dandelion-seedhead/index.md): Build a seed head through its core, stems and parachutes, controlling fine-line density, depth and background contrast. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [67. Paint a snail in Aquarell: wrap a spiral around a rounded shell](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-snail-spiral-shell/index.md): Distinguish a snail’s shell spiral, opening and soft body through overlap and varied edges. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [68. Paint a dragonfly in Aquarell: show direction and transparency in four wings](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-dragonfly-wings/index.md): Arrange a dragonfly’s body and wing roots, suggesting transparency with selected veins, edges and visible background. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [69. Paint a rosette succulent in Aquarell: stagger leaves around layered rings](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-succulent-rosette/index.md): Study the centre, radial direction and overlaps through three staggered rings of fleshy leaves. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [70. Paint a grape cluster in Aquarell: organise rounded forms through overlap](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-grape-cluster/index.md): Build a grape cluster through scale, overlap and shared lighting rather than independently highlighted spheres. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [71. Paint wood end grain in Aquarell: grow rings around an irregular centre](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-wood-endgrain/index.md): Paint a log section with end grain, side grain and cracks, distinguishing surfaces through directional texture. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [72. Paint a broken eggshell in Aquarell: distinguish thin edges, inner wall and outer shell](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-cracked-eggshell/index.md): Study white curved surfaces, broken-edge thickness and interior overlap through two empty shell halves. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [73. Paint a thread of honey in Aquarell: keep viscous liquid connected](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-honey-thread/index.md): Paint honey falling from a spoon through a continuous tapered flow, warm edges and restrained highlights. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [74. Paint a soap bubble in Aquarell: suggest a thin film with lost edges and local colour](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-soap-bubble/index.md): Paint a bubble with broken coloured edges, transmitted background and reflections rather than a solid rainbow sphere. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [75. Paint a candle in Aquarell: separate flame, wax body and drips](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-candle-wax-flame/index.md): Study a candle through flame shape, warm wax transmission, selected drips and coherent shadows. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [76. Paint a fruit stall in Aquarell: layer canopy, shelves and produce](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-fruit-market-stall/index.md): Study broad colour masses, overlaps and information hierarchy in a fictional fruit stall. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [77. Paint a waterfall in Aquarell: distinguish falling water, rock and mist](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-waterfall-flow/index.md): Study directional falling water, a horizontal pool and local mist without turning white water into a paper strip. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [78. Paint a stone arch bridge in Aquarell: connect deck, arch and reflection](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-stone-arch-bridge/index.md): Study a single-arch bridge through its silhouette, arch thickness and open space, with restrained stone texture. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [79. Paint a board-game path in Aquarell: clarify spaces, branches and symbols](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-board-game-path/index.md): Paint a fictional walking-game board, checking space count, sequence, branches and labels alongside illustration. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [80. - [81. Draw a rope knot in Aquarell: trace the continuous path before adding fibres](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-rope-knot-path/index.md): Check a simplified rope knot’s weaving order, rounded form and contact shadows before fibres obscure its path. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [82. Draw a carved knight chess piece in Aquarell: align silhouette, carved planes and base](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-carved-knight-piece/index.md): Study a wooden knight’s head-and-neck silhouette, carved planes and turned base, keeping grain subordinate to structure. - [83. Draw stacked books in Aquarell: distinguish spines, page edges and layers](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-stacked-book-edges/index.md): Study three offset books through box perspective, cover thickness and page texture without treating every side alike. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [84. Draw a folded map in Aquarell: turn printed lines with the folds](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-accordion-map-folds/index.md): Arrange four panels of a partly opened map, checking paper thickness, mountain and valley folds, and a route crossing panels. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [85. Draw a zipper in Aquarell: connect teeth, tape and slider](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-zipper-teeth-slider/index.md): Explain a partly open zipper through repeated teeth, convergence and overlap instead of hiding errors under detail. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [86. Draw a jellyfish in Aquarell: separate bell, inner space and tentacles](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-jellyfish-bell-tentacles/index.md): Study a simplified jellyfish’s translucent bell, rim thickness and layered tentacles without turning it into a glowing umbrella. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [87. Draw an octopus arm in Aquarell: turn suckers around a bending surface](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-octopus-arm-suckers/index.md): Study a curled arm through continuous taper, changing surfaces and sucker perspective rather than flat rows of dots. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [88. Draw a beetle in Aquarell: connect wing cases, thorax and leg roots](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-beetle-shell-leg-roots/index.md): Study a simplified beetle from above through its axis, shell reflections and paired legs with clear attachments. Originally published: 2026-11-03.
- [89. Draw a paper lantern in Aquarell: combine ribs, paper and internal light](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell-paper-lantern-ribs/index.md): Study a rounded paper lantern through its silhouette, circumferential ribs and transmitted light rather than uniform bright fill.
